source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-13 from the binary vector f of length 63 of the submission smolen-2026-11-t5-126at26 (constant on the orbits of x -> 2x). Rows f(x+d) for x in Z63 and their complements, 126 rows, the cyclic construction of Colbourn and Keri 2009. programs/bad5.c lists the 7245 sets of five shifts that miss a pattern; 3528 of them miss one pattern p and its complement. An added row r and its complement repair such a set when r_i + r_j = p_i + p_j on its columns, so one added row and its complement repair every bad set of a family whose equations are consistent. 32 shifts and one added row with its complement, chosen by programs/pick2.py 32 1 1 12 (fixed seed) and built by programs/mk2.py. programs/recipe.sh runs it; two runs from scratch gave the same array (programs/recipe_log.txt). Exact check with ca_verify, all 5-sets
construction: Cyclic array of a binary vector on Z63 and its complements on 32 shifts, with one added row and its complement repairing the remaining bad 5-sets
notes: six rows below the cited size 134 at k = 32, and so at k = 29, 30 and 31
